commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel, to find the Eye of Argonia before the Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) do. The Unbound drain the Hist trees and seal them with paralysis paste, probably to brew a draught to kill the beast guarding the Root. The Eye could heal the trees if used at the Root. 2. Go to the Grey Tooth Cave on Skeith Isle and find what the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) hired men found there. 3. Fight the three hirelings, or slip past them to the cave door. I can also look at Vanin's Rubbing first. Fighting is the build-favoured route. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand, except what the rubbing shows; I can read it to find out.

answer 1. Same hunt for the Eye of Argonia for the Toh-Reel-Ka. The rubbing shows the stone from the Grey Tooth niche was taken to the ship Stormwidow in year 181; the Collector has sold her name to diggers. 2. Go to the Wreck of the Stormwidow on the south-west shore of Skeith Isle and search the hold, the ballast crate, for the kings' stone. 3. Fight or slip past whoever is at the wreck. 4. I do not know what the kings' stone is exactly, or who the diggers are; I would find out at the wreck.

answer 1. I killed three Unbound scouts at the Stormwidow wreck and took the Kings' Marker Stone from the ballast crate. It shows seven towers in water, one cut deeper than the rest, matching the map from Vicrium. I also took the Unbound seal recipe (grey caps and dried root paste, signed C., likely Cuts-the-Old-Knot). 2. Speak to the wounded scout Tah-Leesh below the bow. 3. Talk to her; I could also leave her or kill her. 4. I do not know which of the seven towers is the deep-cut one or where they are; I may learn from Tah-Leesh or the order.

answer 1. Tah-Leesh, a wounded Unbound scout, said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells servants of the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, the Archwardens' fort on the Chixathe Mesa. She does not know what it means. It hints the order hides something, maybe tied to why Nesh-Deeka knows so much. 2. Bring the Kings' Marker Stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. 3. Go straight to Helstrom, and ask Never-Writes-Twice about the Chalkmoth riddle; or investigate Fort Chalkmoth myself. 4. I do not know what moans in Fort Chalkmoth cellar or why the Unbound leader says it. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or Nesh-Deeka, or go to the fort.

answer 1. I gave Never-Writes-Twice the Kings' Marker Stone and got 100 gold. It points to one of seven drowned spires off Lilmoth on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, near the Root where the Eye lies. She dismissed the Fort Chalkmoth riddle as nonsense, which makes me a little suspicious. 2. Go to Bell Station, a salvage islet east of Lilmoth (boat from Lilmoth), and ask the divers which tower it is. Optionally visit Fort Chalkmoth on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara first. 3. Bell Station first for the order's hunt, or Fort Chalkmoth first to see what moans in the cellar. 4. I do not know what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or why she brushed it off; I can only find out by going there.

answer Notes: I am a Toh-Wo of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the Eye of Argonia at the Root before the Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) do. Grey Tooth cave niche was empty; the Stormwidow wreck on Skeith Isle held the Kings' Marker Stone, which I took after killing three Unbound scouts. I also took their Recipe for the Seal (grey caps and dried root paste, signed C.); I still carry it. The stone showed seven drowned towers off Lilmoth, one cut deeper. Never-Writes-Twice took the stone and paid me 100 gold. Next: Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth reached by boat from Lilmoth, where divers will know which tower. Open thread: Cuts-the-Old-Knot says to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara). Never-Writes-Twice brushed it off, so I think the order may hide something and want to see it myself. Tah-Leesh, the wounded scout, is left alive on the sand at the wreck. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is still ahead of us in places.
